'''Darkon Lakade''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who lived during the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Lakade worked for the criminal [[Organization]] of the [[Oblee]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]] at a weapons storage facility on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Rothe Gate]], situated in the [[Cularin asteroid belt]].<ref name="UnderWorld" />

Circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], [[The Cell]]&mdash;a rogue faction of the Organization&mdash;sought to oust Nirama from control of the criminal group. Lakade did not join the faction and remained loyal to Nirama, but The Cell planted false evidence that implicated Lakade as being a member of their group, in an attempt to deceive Nirama into dismissing a loyal employee.<ref name="UnderWorld" />
